text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day at the training course, I spotted Agnes Tachyon calling out to students.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Please, I beg of you~ All you have to do is tell me what kind of dream you had!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...No. I'm training right now, do not disturb me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Then how about you girls? Even if you fall asleep, it will only be for a few minutes, you know? It's just like taking a quick afternoon nap!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: N-N-N-No way! We'll pass! We won't be able to sleep at night!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: I'll pass too! We haven't finished our training yet!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: That's so creepy... What kind of drink lets you sleep comfortably and gives you sweet dreams anyway?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh? What perfect timing. You there, Trainer, care to assist me with an experiment?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Drinking this concoction will grant you a restful slumber and wonderful dreams!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Extremely effective for recovering from fatigue! Come, in exchange, all you need to do is share a little bit about what you dreamed of!
choice_data_list: I guess I have been feeling tired lately...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Splendid! Now then, don't hold back—down the hatch! Bottoms up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I had a dream.
A dream where <chrname> ran freely with marvelous speed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —Oh, are you awake? Fufufu, you look remarkably refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now that is fascinating! You see, the drink from earlier has the effect of making the test subject dream of their deep subconscious.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Upon drinking it, one instantly falls into a pleasant slumber and dreams of the desires and wishes deeply rooted within their heart.
choice_data_list: I... I didn't say any weird sleep-talk, did I...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Fufu, guilty conscience, perhaps? Well, in any case, the core subject of this experiment isn't about the content of your desires.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The clear recognition of "desire" and "wishes." That is the very essence of this experiment!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —What is desire?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It serves as the guideline for one's actions, and is nothing less than the driving force that accelerates growth.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And when that desire is laid bare, the yearning for fulfillment intensifies even further.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What do you want?! What do you wish to achieve?! What kind of power do you seek for that purpose?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Without looking away, gaze deep into it! For that is what leads to the next great leap forward—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...That being said, however, your subconscious is rather dull. To think your sleep-talk consisted entirely of things about your trainee horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Do you really possess no selfish desires, or any direct desire to benefit yourself?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That is just the problem. I had a dream that didn't quite make sense to me, which made me wonder if the formula was a failure.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It was truly... a boring dream. Just a dream of running through a place I've never seen before—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Endlessly fast... without any shackles holding me back...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I felt immensely satisfied, yet it contained nothing resembling a clear desire...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In other words, we both ended up seeing dreams that didn't quite make sense.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: As expected, the formula was incomplete. There seems to be room for improvement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later, while walking down the hallway, Agnes Tachyon called out to stop me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Just in time. I've adjusted the ingredients of the other day's formula. By all means, as my test subject—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Chilled by the words "test subject," I panicked and bolted away from the scene.
